performers.title: 🚀 Water on Mars: The Vanishing Act
performers.hook: Pour water on Mars and it vanishes
performers.script: Pour water on Mars and it vanishes. Thin atmosphere, low pressure. Water boils instantly, then freezes. On Venus, it's crushed by pressure. On Jupiter, it's lost in gas. But what happens to water on other planets? Pour water on Mars and it vanishes

performers.title: HOW IT WORKS #20 | 🔭 Gold Mirror Reveals the Universe’s First Light!
performers.hook: A 20‑kilogram gold mirror peers back 13 billion years.
performers.script: A 20‑kilogram gold mirror peers back 13 billion years. JWST’s 18 hexagonal segments are coated in a thin layer of gold, turning invisible infrared photons into bright reflections. The reflected light races through a chilled instrument suite to detectors that turn ancient heat signatures into images. Each photon carries the universe’s earliest glow, stretched by expansion into the infrared we can now capture. A crystal‑clear snapshot of the cosmos when it was only a few hundred million years old, the baby picture of everything we see today.
performers.topic: James Webb Telescope's gold-coated mirror and early galaxies

performers.title: 🔢 The Collatz Enigma
performers.script: Multiply by 3 and add 1. Numbers collapse. Patterns emerge. But what happens next? The Collatz Conjecture remains unsolved. Multiply by 3 and add 1.

performers.title: HOW IT WORKS #1 | 🚂 Train in a Vacuum 🌀
performers.hook: Ride a train through a mountain and you're in a vacuum
performers.script: Ride a train through a mountain and you're in a vacuum. Air is removed to reduce friction. The train accelerates, using less energy. In the tunnel, pressure is low, and air would expand dangerously. So, a vacuum is created, reducing air resistance. Ride a train through a mountain and you're in a vacuum
